data.title: Marriott Residences
data.about:
Marriott Residences JLT presents an exclusive opportunity to experience branded luxury in the heart of Jumeirah Lake Towers. With a flexible 3-year post-handover payment plan, this prestigious 54-floor off-plan development offers a refined urban lifestyle with 535 meticulously designed residences. Future homeowners can choose from elegantly crafted 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each reflecting the sophisticated standards of Marriott-branded living. With its prime location and world-class amenities, Marriott Residences in JLT is set to redefine modern high-rise living in Dubai.

Designed to offer an unparalleled residential experience, Marriott Residences by Saba Properties boasts an array of exceptional lifestyle amenities. Residents will enjoy an infinity open pool, state-of-the-art gyms, a sun bed water area, an open-air theatre, and a dedicated yoga room. The community-centric design also includes barbecue zones, a kids’ pool and play area, a communal lounge, and a games room. Blending contemporary elegance with comfort, Marriott Residences at JLT is an ideal choice for discerning buyers seeking a prestigious address in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Exclusive Marriott Living in the Heart of JLT!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Premium Branded Living: Developed by Saba Properties, Marriott Residences JLT offers exclusive hospitality-inspired living in the heart of Dubai.
  • Premium Apartments: Thoughtfully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, blending contemporary aesthetics with superior comfort and style.
  • Prime Location: Ideally situated on First Al Khail Street in Jumeirah Lake Towers, offering seamless connectivity and urban convenience.
  • High ROI: A prestigious investment opportunity with strong rental demand and promising capital appreciation in Dubai’s thriving property market.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Pay 50% during construction, 15% on handover, and 35% over 3 years post-handover, making it a convenient investment opportunity.

location_tile.title: A Prime Address in JLT with Seamless Connectivity Across Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Strategically located on First Al Khail Street, Marriott Residences at JLT offers unmatched convenience with effortless access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), just a five-minute drive away. This central positioning ensures swift connectivity to key business hubs, vibrant leisure destinations, and renowned attractions, making it an ideal choice for both residents and investors seeking a well-connected urban lifestyle.

  • 9 Minutes – Dubai Marina Mall
  • 9 Minutes – JBR
  • 14 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates        
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Mall
